$comment: GENERATED by scripts/gen_narrative.py from spec/narrative.v1.json — DO NOT EDIT. Handed to `claude -p --json-schema`.
title: BuilderNarrative
description: How one person works, written back to them from measurements of their own sessions. Every claim carries a number that appears in the input. A number that does not appear in the input is the worst thing this document can contain, because the reader will believe it.

archetype_line.description: what this person's archetype means for THEM, naming the measurement that earned it. Never a definition of the archetype in general. Empty when the check took it back. (max 220 chars)

how_you_work.description: how they actually work, one paragraph per comparative finding: what they do, and what it costs them or gains them. A paragraph whose only content is a ratio or a share is a paragraph to delete. (each max 400 chars, 2 to 3 items)

strengths.description: what they are good at, each with the measurement under it. (1 to 3 items)

watch_outs.description: what the same numbers suggest is costing them, each with the measurement under it. Never a scolding. (1 to 3 items)

one_experiment.description: one concrete thing to try next session, small enough to do, tied to a number above so they can tell whether it worked. (max 260 chars)

text.description: the claim, in the second person, no numbers needed here. (max 160 chars)

evidence.description: the numbers behind it, copied from the input. Never a number the input did not contain. (max 160 chars)
